summary: Iteration 13 backend regression — verified two hardening fixes since iter12: (1) /api/metadata/{rk}/children on a movie rating_key now returns 200 {items:[]} instead of 500 (confirmed with real movie rk from user's Plex library); (2) /api/stream/{rk}?direct=true on a show rating_key now returns 400 with detail mentioning show/episode/season (confirmed on real show rk). Regressions verified: /children on show still returns >=1 season; /stream on movie still returns {url,type}; /stream on IPTV live channel still returns {url,type:'hls'}; /api/livetv/channels IPTV enrichment (country/genre/category_id/category_name) intact; /api/me/live/favorites & /api/me/live/recent CRUD unaffected. 8/8 new iter13 tests + 18/18 prior regression tests = 26/26 pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 2294 lines — trending up over iterations; still a candidate for modularization (live TV classifier / iptv proxy / me endpoints / stream helpers).

In metadata_children the except catches httpx.HTTPStatusError and returns {items:[]} for 400/404 — correct, but silently swallowing 404 for a rating_key that truly doesn't exist (bad id) also returns {items:[]}. That is acceptable UX (empty state) but could hide bugs; consider logging the swallowed status at DEBUG.

In stream_url the show/season guard uses items[0].get('type').lower() and checks {'show','season','artist','album'}. Good — covers music containers. Consider also including 'collection' if Plex ever returns that at this endpoint (currently would fall through and 404-ish on missing Part).

The 400 detail message is human-readable ('Cannot play a show directly — please pick an episode/track first.') but not localized/i18n-friendly. If mobile client string-matches to decide UI behavior, prefer a structured error code (e.g., detail={'code':'NEEDS_EPISODE','message':...}).
